name: linkedin-to-jsonresume
description: Browser extension (Firefox / Chrome) that exports your open LinkedIn profile to JSON Resume
author: Owen Moogk (fork of Joshua Tzucker's linkedin-to-jsonresume)

scripts.build: vite build --mode popup && vite build --mode content
scripts.package: yarn build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.ver:major: git pull && yarn version --major && git push && git push --tags
scripts.ver:minor: git pull && yarn version --minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.ver:patch: git pull && yarn version --patch && git push && git push --tags
